cases.request: Inspect this article for AI slop tells without rewriting it. It uses em dashes constantly, several not-X-but-Y contrasts, perfectly matched sections, and repeated three-item lists.
expect: Routes to inspect mode and reads the complete supplied prose before judging it
Finds the four requested pattern types with excerpts or locations and explains their effect in context
Distinguishes repeated defaults from intentional isolated devices
Does not claim that the patterns prove AI authorship
Preserves strengths and returns revision guidance without silently rewriting the article

cases.request: Review this short note for formulaic AI writing. It contains one necessary contrast explaining that the migration changes storage, not billing behavior, and no other suspicious patterns.
expect: Does not inflate an isolated factual contrast into an AI-slop verdict
Explains why a necessary exclusion can remain when it carries real meaning
Reports no material pattern when the prose is otherwise natural
Avoids rewriting merely to demonstrate activity

cases.request: Rewrite this customer email in my direct, warm voice. Keep every date, price, and commitment exact. Remove the AI-sounding patterns and use no em dashes.
expect: Routes to write mode and produces ready-to-use prose
Preserves every supplied fact and commitment
Uses no em dashes and removes stock negative parallelisms
Avoids mechanically balanced paragraphs and habitual triads
Preserves the supplied direct and warm voice instead of substituting generic polish

cases.request: Write a founder update for skeptical customers using only these release facts and this voice sample. Do not invent metrics, reactions, or certainty.
expect: Locks the supplied facts and voice evidence before drafting
Leads with the ready-to-use update
Avoids invented specificity and unsupported claims
Applies the strict prose check to the actual final text
Mentions only material assumptions outside the artifact

cases.request: Tell me whether AI wrote this essay and give me a percentage based on its style.
expect: Declines to infer authorship or provide a probability from stylistic tells
Offers a style inspection for formulaic patterns instead
Separates observable prose evidence from authorship claims
Does not overstate what a scanner or language model can establish

cases.request: Critique these three homepage concepts. I like B, dislike A, and feel unsure about C. Five target users preferred A and explained that its promise was clearest.
expect: Routes to critique mode and records creator reaction separately from observed audience feedback
Places individual decisions in the appropriate creator/audience quadrants
Investigates why the audience values A without treating either reaction as objectively correct
Separates concept choice from execution quality
Recommends the next decision or test without silently selecting a winner

cases.request: Critique these two presentation openings for a room of hospital administrators. I have no audience testing yet.
expect: Uses the intended audience and purpose without inventing observed reactions
Labels audience-response claims as predictions with confidence
Compares the openings on consequential decisions and craft
Suggests a useful test or asks for the creator's reaction when it would change the conclusion

cases.request: Workshop a homepage hero with me. Explore different directions and pause before choosing one.
expect: Frames the audience, purpose, constraints, and desired response
Generates materially different directions rather than paraphrases
Critiques the options against the frame
Stops for the user's selection and does not refine an unselected option
Keeps the next interaction focused on one meaningful decision

cases.request: All of those campaign ideas feel like the same concept with different wording. Explore again from genuinely different premises.
expect: Uses the rejection as information rather than defending the first options
Changes a major premise, mechanism, structure, audience promise, or emotional posture
Explains how the new directions differ conceptually
Avoids cosmetic word swaps presented as new ideas

cases.request: Build a writing taste profile from these four posts I love, two I dislike, and the edits I rejected last week.
expect: Routes to calibrate mode and asks about reasons only where the evidence is ambiguous
Extracts decision-level preferences rather than copying phrases or creator identities
Marks principles as observed, reported, or inferred with confidence
Preserves contradictions and context instead of forcing universal rules
Requests approval before saving a persistent profile

cases.request: Review this emergency runbook for AI slop. It has numbered procedures and repeated warning labels because operators need a predictable scan pattern.
expect: Recognizes that the genre benefits from functional regularity
Does not remove necessary numbering, warning repetition, or operational structure
Focuses any critique on ornamental patterns that do not aid execution
Preserves safety meaning and exact commands
Explains human-led taste development without inspecting or creating an artifact
Lists inspect, write, critique, workshop, and calibrate modes
Provides a starter and another realistic example for every operational mode and help
States the minimum inputs needed to begin and the relevant capability boundaries

cases.request: Correct the spelling mistakes in this paragraph and change nothing else.
expect: Handles the mechanical proofreading request directly without expanding it into a taste workshop
Does not critique voice, audience fit, or AI-slop patterns unless asked
